methods.label: Evaluate the powers
methods.explanation:
A negative exponent means taking the reciprocal, so
\[
2^3=8,\qquad 2^{-3}=\frac1{2^3}=\frac18.
\]
The denominator is \(\frac18+\frac18=\frac14\), which is nonzero. Therefore
\[
\frac{2^3+2^3}{2^{-3}+2^{-3}}
=\frac{8+8}{\frac18+\frac18}
=16\div\frac14
=\boxed{64},
\]
choice E.
